Each cutaway is sharp and remains on screen for several seconds. The speaker remains the primary focus, but these overlays provide visual context for her technical explanation. The camera remains static at eye-level, maintaining a conversational and trustworthy atmosphere between the expert and the viewer. (5) More severe skin reaction photos are shown, featuring intense redness and large areas of peeling skin. Large red "X" symbols are overlaid on these more extreme cases to differentiate them from the mild peeling discussed earlier. This visual comparison helps viewers understand the range of possible skin responses. (6) The video concludes with a transition to a high-contrast information screen. This final visual phase displays the clinic branding, along with specific contact information including phone numbers and physical addresses in New Taipei and Taipei. A Line ID handle is also provided, encouraging viewers to take direct action and reach out for consultations.
